name: Eden AI
short: European multi-AI API aggregator connecting ~1,000 models across LLMs, translation, vision, and speech with zero model markup, automatic catalog updates, and unified billing.

plans.name: Free trial credits
plans.notes: Starter trial credits upon account signup without credit card upfront to test and benchmark models across the catalog.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Zero markup on underlying provider token rates; 5.5% platform fee on credit balance refills; access to 1,000+ models, unified keys, latency tracking, and cost analytics.

plans.name: Advanced / Enterprise
plans.notes: Volume pricing, dedicated throughput, customized routing, SLAs, private VPC deployments, and EU sovereign data residency options.
